Redwood troubleshooting & recommendations shared (high-level):
- Region choice: recommend using region nearest user base; default for their NA-heavy customers = us-east-1 for lowest network hop; for EU segment use eu-west-1. For mixed audience, route by geo at CDN/load balancer layer and use per-request region header.
- Timeouts: suggest client-side read timeout = 30s, idle/keepalive = 60s; set request-level deadline shorter than UI spinner threshold (e.g., 10s) and show graceful fallback copy if >10s.
- Streaming: enable streaming to reduce time-to-first-token; consider sending partial content to UI while model finishes. Streaming reduced time-to-first-token by ~40% during SE test.
- Prompt length: limit prompt + context to ~800 tokens for interactive chat; for long histories use condensed system summaries or periodic compression (tooling: local summarizer + store summary). Trim doc sources before generation; move embeddings/search for KB retrieval to reduce tokens.
- Batching/throughput: for their low QPS keep batching off or set max_batch_ms low (5-10ms) to avoid queueing latency. Continuous batching benefits high-throughput customers only.
- Retry & fallback: configure simple exponential backoff (initial 200ms, max 2s) and a fallback route to lower-cost smaller model variant for degraded cases.
- Connection hints: enable HTTP keep-alive, reuse connections; enforce TLS session reuse where possible.
